subject: Onramp trial playbook: metrics, roles, 3-week runway
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@onramp.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + proposed 3-week trial plan (Onramp)

Hi Ava / Diego —

Thanks again for a great call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight trial playbook so we can align on success and get to a meaningful decision within 3 weeks. Attached is a one-pager plus a short mutual action plan.

High-level proposal (3-week runway):
- Week 0 (kickoff): ingest sample workload, configure model variant, baseline current latency/throughput.
- Week 1 (stress + QoQ): run production-like traffic profile for peak 1-2 hours/day + collect quality samples.
- Week 2 (optimization + validation): iterate on batching/quantization settings, run 24h stability window.

Proposed success criteria (need your confirmation):
- Latency p95 <= 220ms for 256-token requests (target profile)
- Throughput >= 120 qps sustained for 5min window on your test harness
- Cost <= $0.008 / token (after initial optimizations)
- Quality: top-line accuracy metric (intent match) >= 92% vs your golden set; acceptable error mode triage defined

Ownership suggestions (open to adjustments):
- Redwood: runtime config, quantization trials, telemetry dashboard, short ops runbook (Ben).
- Onramp: sample traffic harness, golden-label set, procurement for dedicated sandbox (Ava / Diego).

Next steps:
1) You confirm the KPIs above and any additions by EOD Thu 8/19.
2) We schedule a 45-minute kickoff for Mon 8/21 to onboard traffic and keys.
3) Redwood delivers preliminary config + cost estimate within 48h of kickoff.

Attachments: onramp_trial_playbook_v1.pdf (playbook), mutual-action-plan-onramp.xlsx (owners/timeline), latency-throughput-example.csv (sample baselines).

If any of this is off the mark, tell me which item you'd like to change and we'll update.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@onramp.health>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@onramp.health>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed 3-week trial plan (Onramp)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear write-up. This looks like a great starting point. A few quick notes from our side:

- Latency: 220ms p95 is reasonable as a goal; can we also track p99 as a hard flag (we'll flag if p99 > 500ms)?
- Throughput: our initial traffic generator mimics peak of ~90 qps for our busiest endpoints — 120 qps gives us headroom which is good.
- Cost: the $0.008/token target is aggressive — can you clarify assumptions (model size, quantization)?
- Quality: we have a 1,200-sample golden set we can share; our definition of intent match is slightly stricter — we'll send a sample mapping doc.

We can confirm KPIs by Thu EOD. Kickoff on Mon 8/21 is fine; Diego will own the traffic harness.

Ava Collins
Senior PM, Integrations | Onramp Health
ava.collins@onramp.health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@onramp.health>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed 3-week trial plan (Onramp)

Ava —

Quick note on cost assumptions so Ava and Diego have visibility before kickoff:
- Baseline model: open-llama-7b equivalent (FP16 run) for initial run, then 4-bit quant for optimized run.
- Cost estimate of $0.008/token assumes we can hit continuous batching and the 4-bit quant profile during Week 2; initial Week 0/1 runs may be closer to $0.015/token.
- We will provide per-token cost breakdown in the dashboard and an estimate in the pre-kickoff config deliverable.

Also attaching a small sample of what the telemetry dashboard will show (latency percentiles, qps, token cost).

Ben Carter
Trial Success Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@onramp.health>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ava Collins <ava.collins@onramp.health>
Date: 2026-08-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed 3-week trial plan (Onramp)

Thanks — couple clarifying Qs before kickoff:
1) For the throughput test, can you provide the exact request shape (avg tokens in / out) you expect so we can instrument the harness correctly?
2) Will Redwood host the model variant in a dedicated sandbox or do we run in our VPC (we prefer sandbox for speed)?

Date: 2026-08-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed 3-week trial plan (Onramp)

Diego —

Answers inline:
1) Request shape: our baseline tests use a 250-token input / 40-token generation profile. We'll attach a sample payload (included in the Drive link). If your traffic median is lower, we can mirror that; we just need the token distribution to model latency/batching.
2) Hosting: we can do either. For speed-to-results (and to avoid VPC setup delays) we recommend Redwood-hosted dedicated sandbox for the 3-week trial. We will provide data handling controls and a short SOC2-aligned checklist. If you need VPC from day 0, raise it now and we'll add time to the runway.

Can you confirm you want Redwood-hosted sandbox? If so we'll provision credentials pre-kickoff.

Jordan
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@onramp.health>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@onramp.health>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed 3-week trial plan (Onramp)

Jordan / Ben —

Confirmed: Onramp agrees to Redwood-hosted dedicated sandbox for the initial 3-week run; Diego will send the golden set sample and request shape by EOD 8/20.

KPIs: p95 <= 220ms, p99 hard flag at 500ms, throughput target 120 qps headroom (we'll validate against our harness), cost target understood with staging caveat (Ben noted initial warmup cost). On quality, we'll share the 1,200-sample set and mapping notes — expect that by end of day.

Kickoff: Monday 8/21 10:00am PT. Please send calendar invite + pre-kickoff checklist with credentials and test harness link.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Ava
